answers.core: This is part of core editor functionality, it doesn't seem reasonable to expect users to install an asset for something like this.
answers.workaround:
Not with a script. As mentioned before, I can manually edit the theme resource file, but it's not intuitive and has error potential.

(Also, in my opinion, a graphical interface should provide a GUI-based solution to interactions.)
